The bundle directory is created and named by the dispatcher; bundle_id in this manifest is the authoritative id.

Copied text (the owner's own configuration and log files, and the command line and image path of the one named helper process) stays readable, except that every Windows user profile folder name, every e-mail shaped token, every UNC host name and every hardware address in it is a pseudonym (user-<12 hex>, mail-<12 hex>, host-<12 hex>, mac-<12 hex>) keyed with a random salt that was not stored; result.json of each copy records the SHA-256 of the original bytes and the replacement counts, so a copy with zero replacements and the same hash is verbatim.

Network names, hardware addresses and Bluetooth peer names are pseudonyms (ssid-<12 hex>, mac-<12 hex>, name-<12 hex>) keyed with a random salt that was not stored: the same value maps to the same pseudonym inside this bundle and to nothing outside it. The saved Wi-Fi profiles of this PC are the exception: they are the owner's own networks and stay readable, each with its pseudonym, so an explicit owner selection can be matched at analysis time.
This bundle holds capture output only. Decoded tables, evidence rows and a verdict are written later, off the machine.
